raw_graphql_pull_request.body: ## Motivation I met data corruption on 4\*A100 `Qwen3-30B-A3B`, and 8\*L20 `Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507-FP8` when enabling EPLB: ``` python3 -m sglang.launch_server \ --model-path /data/Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507-FP8 \ --host 0.0.0.0 \ --port 30000 \ --tp-size 8 \ --ep-size 8 \ --disable-custom-all-reduce \ --enable-eplb \ --ep-num-redundant-experts 8 \ --eplb-rebalance-num-iterations 100 \ --expert-distribution-recorder-mode stat \ --log-level info \ 2>&1 | tee eplb-qwen3-235b.log python3 -m sglang.launch_server \ --model-path /mnt/disk4/abc/Qwen3-30B-A3B \ --host 0.0.0.0 \ --port 30000 \ --tp-size 4 \ --ep-size 4 \ --disable-custom-all-reduce \ --enable-eplb \ --ep-num-redundant-experts 4 \ --eplb-rebalance-num-iterations 100 \ --expert-distribution-recorder-mode stat \ --expert-balancedness-report-mode server_log \ --log-level info \ 2>&1 | tee eplb.log ``` When the prompt's `max_tokens` exceeds the `--eplb-rebalance-num-iterations`, the answer turns to be corrupted at the tail of the output after the rebalance. ## Modifications Apply the fix introduced in #18213 to the analogous Qwen3 MoE path by passing expert-location dispatch information to `TopK` in `forward_normal()`. ## Accuracy Tests ## Speed Tests and Profiling ## Checklist - files.patch:
@@ -338,10 +338,20 @@ def forward_normal(
         num_tokens, hidden_dim = hidden_states.shape
         hidden_states = hidden_states.view(-1, hidden_dim)
 
+        dispatch_info = (
+            ExpertLocationDispatchInfo.init_new(layer_id=self.layer_id)
+            if get_exec().moe.enable_eplb
+            else None
+        )
+
         if hidden_states.shape[0] > 0:
             # router_logits: (num_tokens, n_experts)
             router_logits, _ = self.gate(hidden_states)
-            topk_output = self.topk(hidden_states, router_logits)
+            topk_output = self.topk(
+                hidden_states,
+                router_logits,
+                expert_location_dispatch_info=dispatch_info,
+            )
         else:
             topk_output = self.topk.empty_topk_output(hidden_states.device)
         final_hidden_states = self.experts(hidden_states, topk_output)
